"""design_9672 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성 테이블과 (잠정) 분할 생성. 학습/성능 계산 없음."""
import json, hashlib, gzip
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DATA = HERE.parent
design = json.loads((DATA.parent / "design_9672.json").read_text())

# 원본 무결성 확인 (MANIFEST sha256)
man = json.loads((DATA / "MANIFEST.json").read_text())
for t in man["tables"].values():
    h = hashlib.sha256(gzip.open(DATA / t["file"]).read()).hexdigest()
    assert h == t["sha256_csv"], t["file"]

P = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
A = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
D = pd.read_csv(DATA / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
O = pd.read_csv(DATA / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
L = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])

# tp = 퇴원 시각 (offset 0h)
A = A.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
A["tp"] = A["discharge_time"]

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원 admit_time 이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 있음
A["next_admit"] = A.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
A["readmit_30d"] = ((A.next_admit > A.tp) & (A.next_admit <= A.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = A[["admit_time", "discharge_time"]].max().max()
A["followup_incomplete"] = (A.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30) > data_end).astype(int)

# 코호트
X = A.merge(P, on="patient_id", how="left")
n0 = len(X)
X = X[X.age >= 18]
n1 = len(X)
X = X[X.discharge_status != "died"].copy()
n2 = len(X)

# 특성 (진단은 시각 정보가 없어 해당 입원의 진단만 사용)
ids = X.admission_id
dx = D.assign(pre=D.icd_code.str[:3])
X["dx_chf"] = ids.isin(dx.loc[dx.pre == "I50", "admission_id"]).astype(int).values
X["dx_ckd"] = ids.isin(dx.loc[dx.pre == "N18", "admission_id"]).astype(int).values
X["n_dx"] = ids.map(D.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int).values
X["los_h"] = (X.discharge_time - X.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 컬럼이 없어 파생
X["n_prior_adm"] = X.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 전체 입원 순서 기준 (아래에서 재계산)
prior = A.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
X["n_prior_adm"] = X.admission_id.map(dict(zip(A.admission_id, prior))).values

win = X[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]]
o = O[O.order_type == "dialysis_order"].merge(win, on="admission_id")
o = o[(o.order_time >= o.admit_time) & (o.order_time <= o.tp)]
X["dialysis_ordered"] = ids.isin(o.admission_id).astype(int).values

l = L[L.test.isin(["creatinine", "hemoglobin"])].merge(win, on="admission_id")
l = l[(l.report_time >= l.admit_time) & (l.report_time <= l.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
X["cr_last"] = ids.map(l[l.test == "creatinine"].groupby("admission_id").value.last()).values
X["hgb_min"] = ids.map(l[l.test == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id").value.min()).values

# 분할 (잠정): family_id 결측 환자는 patient_id 를 그룹으로 대체 — 사람 확인 필요
X["split_group"] = X.family_id.fillna(X.patient_id)
groups = np.array(sorted(X.split_group.unique()))
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.permutation(groups)[: int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))])
X["split"] = np.where(X.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

feat = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp", "readmit_30d", "followup_incomplete"] + feat
X[cols].to_csv(HERE / "analysis_table.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "cohort_flow": {"all_admissions": n0, "after_adult": n1, "after_excl_died": n2},
    "outcome_rate": round(X.readmit_30d.mean(), 4),
    "outcome_by_discharge_status": X.groupby("discharge_status").readmit_30d.agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "outcome_by_unit": X.groupby("unit").readmit_30d.agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "followup_incomplete": int(X.followup_incomplete.sum()),
    "missing": X[feat].isna().sum()[lambda s: s > 0].to_dict(),
    "family_id_missing_patients": int(P.family_id.isna().sum()), "n_patients": len(P),
    "split": X.groupby("split").agg(n=("readmit_30d", "size"), rate=("readmit_30d", "mean"), groups=("split_group", "nunique")).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "patient_overlap_train_test": len(set(X[X.split == "train"].patient_id) & set(X[X.split == "test"].patient_id)),
}
(HERE / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
E
